## Slide 1 {#slide-1}

<button type="button">Button on slide-1</button>

<script>
document.querySelector('.reveal').addEventListener('slidechanged', (e) => {
  const target = e.currentSlide.querySelector('.focus-on-enter');
  if (target) target.focus();
});
</script>
